title: Capricorn Emoji ♑ Meaning: The Sea-Goat Who Gets It Done
description: The ♑ Capricorn emoji is the zodiac sign of the Sea-Goat, December 22 to January 19. See what it says about ambition, work, and dry humor in posts.
summary: The ♑ Capricorn emoji stands for Capricorn, the Sea-Goat, the zodiac sign for birthdays from about December 22 to January 19. People use it to name their sign and to joke about being ambitious, disciplined, work-obsessed, and emotionally reserved.
meaning: ♑ is the least pictorial of the zodiac glyphs: a pointed stroke like a V that runs into a looping tail. It abbreviates one of the stranger figures in the sky, a goat with the tail of a fish, a creature with roots in ancient Mesopotamian star lore. As an emoji it tags the tenth sign, whose season begins at the December solstice and spans the New Year.

Astrologers describe Capricorn as cardinal earth under the rule of Saturn, the planet of structure and limits. The sign's reputation is accordingly sober: responsible, patient, strategic, ambitious. On social media that turns into the friend who has a five-year plan, answers email on vacation, and shows affection by fixing your résumé. "CEO of the zodiac" is a common tag.

Capricorns post ♑ with deadpan pride, often about work: closing a deal, hitting a savings goal, going to bed at ten. The timing helps. Capricorn season coincides with New Year's resolutions, so astrology accounts tie the sign to goal-setting content every January. The emoji is also used to gently mock someone who cannot relax, or to compliment the one person in the group who is reliably on time.

contexts.label: In bios and birthday posts
contexts.body: People born around the winter holidays use ♑ with their date, sometimes with a complaint about birthdays lost in the Christmas and New Year rush. Career-focused profiles occasionally include it as a personality cue. It appears in three-sign chart listings like any other zodiac emoji.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It follows messages about overtime, budgeting, or declining a night out to be productive. Friends use it to rib the planner who sends calendar invites for brunch. It can also acknowledge emotional restraint: "I did feel something, I just didn't show it ♑."

contexts.label: At work
contexts.body: Among colleagues who chat about astrology, ♑ is a compliment for diligence or a joke about the person who schedules meetings about meetings. It suits informal channels only. Many people will not recognize the glyph, so it does not belong in client-facing messages.

examples.meaning: A brag about being responsible ahead of schedule.
A birthday post that leans into Capricorn ambition.
The sender admits they cannot stop working, even on vacation.

examples.meaning: A New Year caption linking the sign with planning.

examples.text: My love language is sending you a spreadsheet ♑
examples.meaning: A joke that Capricorns show care through practical help.

combos.meaning: Capricorn and its goat; also a playful "greatest of all time" boast.
Steady climbing toward a goal, like a mountain goat.

confusedWith.difference: 🐐 is the animal and, in slang, the GOAT, greatest of all time. Capricorns enjoy the overlap. ♑ is the zodiac glyph and does not carry the sports-praise meaning by itself.

♈ is the Ram, another horned sign, for spring birthdays. People who think of both as "the goat one" swap them. Aries is a simple symmetrical pair of horns; Capricorn is an asymmetrical squiggle with a loop.

avoid: Do not use ♑ to call someone cold or boring unless you know they will laugh.
Avoid relying on the glyph alone with readers unfamiliar with astrology, since it is the hardest zodiac symbol to recognize.
design: A white glyph made of a sharp V-like stroke that continues into a rounded loop and tail, displayed on a purple square. The symbol has more than one accepted written form, so its exact curves differ slightly between fonts and platforms, but every version keeps the point at the front and the loop at the back.

faqs.a: About December 22 to January 19. It starts at the December solstice after Sagittarius and gives way to Aquarius. The first and last days vary slightly with the year.

faqs.q: Why is Capricorn a sea-goat and not just a goat?
faqs.a: The constellation was pictured in ancient Mesopotamia as a goat with a fish's tail, and the image passed to the Greeks and Romans. Modern shorthand often says "the Goat," but the traditional figure is the hybrid.

faqs.q: What does ♑ mean in a bio?
faqs.a: The person's sun sign is Capricorn, or it is one of their main chart placements. Informally it suggests they see themselves as driven and dependable.

faqs.q: What element and planet go with Capricorn?
faqs.a: Capricorn is an earth sign, grouped with Taurus and Virgo, and its ruling planet in astrology is Saturn. Those associations are the source of its image as practical, disciplined, and serious.
